metadata.chunk_title: Online Master of Science in Technical Communication + Build advanced technical writing and communication skills + Technical communication graduate courses and culminating experience

facts.value: The field of technical communication meets at the intersection of writing, design and technology. Arizona State University's online Master of Science in technical communication prepares working professionals to move into senior roles in content strategy, information design and communication leadership. You'll build the technical writing, visual design and research skills to turn complex information into clear, usable content. The curriculum is project-based and designed to fit around your career.
